mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Member (member_id, login_id, password, name, email, kakao_id, balance, point, role) VALUES (member_seq.NEXTVAL, #{loginId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, #{kakaoId}, 0, 0, 'USER')
mapper.select: SELECT member_id AS member_Id, login_id AS login_Id, password, name, email, kakao_id AS kakao_Id, balance, point, role, created_at AS createdAt FROM Member WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
